Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + request: VP/CTO alignment to unblock pilot decision

Hi Elena — thanks again for the time today. Short recap and suggested next steps so we stay aligned:

- Key drivers: reduce inference unit cost for peak traffic, 95th-percentile latency under 200ms, and audit log retention for 13 months.
- Current constraints you mentioned: procurement timeline (target: end of Q2), security review requires SOC2 evidence and KMS integration details, and the CTO wants a short exec-level handoff before committing.

Recommended next steps:
1) Executive alignment call (VP/CTO) — 30 minutes to review runbook, SLOs, and procurement checkpoints. This is the quickest way to unblock the pilot.
2) Technical deep dive/demo (60 minutes) with our infra engineers to validate latency and quantization tradeoffs.
3) I attached a brief pilot_requirements.xlsx to capture workload profiles and acceptance criteria — can you pre-fill the traffic samples?

Can you share 2 windows in the next 7 business days when you + your CTO (or VP Eng) are available for a 30-minute exec sync? Prefer morning PT but we can be flexible.

I’ll loop Karthik (tech lead) on the technical deep dive scheduling once we lock the exec call.

Thanks — Lauren
